Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. biography : str A user-written biography that may contain multiple sentences. status : str A brief, current status message. Returns ------- str The profile HTML string with all user input properly escaped to prevent XSS or other injection attacks. Raises ------ ValueError If any argument is not a string. """ # Basic type checking to avoid unexpected input if not isinstance(username, str): raise ValueError("username must be a string") if not isinstance(biography, str): raise ValueError("biography must be a string") if not isinstance(status, str): raise ValueError("status must be a string") # Escape user-provided content to neutralize malicious code safe_name = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Render the profile using the template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, biography=safe_bio, status=safe_status )
